name: Lex Vermilion
description: Rice-paper warm white with true ink type and a single cinnabar-red accent used like a chop stamp. All-serif (Noto Serif SC + Source Serif 4), zero-radius cards, paper-fiber texture. Reads like a stamped legal document — bright, formal, statute-friendly.
